strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺の身体中にビリビリと電気が走った。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………困っちゃったなあ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………何か困ってるのかな？
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うん。見た目はあんまりでかくないんだなって。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………何の話よ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: えっ、えへへへ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ちょっと、あんた、もしかして変態？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: え？　変態？　何だ変態って？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ふう………もういいわよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あんたと話していると疲れちゃうわ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………あ、そうだわ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そういうと、お澄まし女はおもむろにトビラの方に近づいて、何かのボタンをカチャカチャ押し始めた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あれ………何よ、これ………全然、通じないじゃない。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 冗談じゃないわ、何の為の非常用のボタンなのよ、もう………！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 何だかわからないけど、怒っているみたいだ。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だけど、俺、別に怒らせるような事、してないよなぁ………。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 振り向いた女と目があうと、女は困ったような顔をすると上着を脱いで、床に座った。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: これじゃあ、収録に間に合いそうにないわ………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あ～あ………また、あのうるさいマネージャーに怒られちゃうのかなあ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 間に合わない？　何が間に合わないだろ？
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ねぇ、どうかしたの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ９時からドラマの収録の予定だったのよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そう言うと、大きなため息をついた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ドラマー？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: へえ、お前、太鼓叩いてんだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺がそう言うと、彼女は何を言ってるのよ、というような顔をした。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あっ………違ったかな？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: もしかして、あなた………私の事、知らないの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 知ってるも何も、お前とは、今、会ったばかりじゃないか。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………本当に知らないの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: じゃあ、「水野　麻梨」って聞いた事は？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 「水野　麻梨」？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………何をやっている人？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 何をやってるって、一応、アイドルで、ドラマとか、ＣＭとかに出ているんだけど………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………あなた………からかっている訳じゃないわよね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………じゃあ、本当に知らないんだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺はうんとうなずくと、彼女はとてもがっかりした様子だった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: じゃあ、お前がその「水野　麻梨」なの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 彼女は返事もせず、ただうなずいただけだった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………そうか、この子、人気があって有名なんだ。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺が知らないと言った事で、彼女を傷つけてしまったんだな。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: お前………さっき、何かが間に合わないとか言ってなかったっけ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ああ、もういいのよ、どうせ人気のタレントをかき集めただけの下らない内容のドラマだから。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 出てる俳優は全然、やる気ないし、なげやりな脚本だし、プロデューサーは暇さえあれば、つきあえってうるさいし。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あっ………あなたには、どうでもいい事だったわね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 所詮、私ってただの捨て石アイドルだもの………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 何だかわからないけど、すごくがっかりしているようだ。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: やっぱり俺、何か悪い事を言っちゃったのかな？
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺、あんまりＴＶとか見なくてさ………その、芸能人とかってほとんど知らないんだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だから、俺がお前の事を知らなくても、そんなにがっかりしなくてもいいよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………あなた………変わっている人ね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: えっ………どうして？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だって、ＴＶとか見ないなんて………あんまりそういう人っていないじゃない。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まるで昔の人みたいだもの………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………うん………まあ、半分、当たっているかもね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺、じいちゃんと二人暮らしなんだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: おじいさんと二人で？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: へぇ………そうなんだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: お父さんやお母さんは？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………いないよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 死んじゃったの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ううん………俺、赤ん坊の頃にじいちゃんに拾われたんだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だから母ちゃんも、父ちゃんも知らないんだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………気の毒なのね………あなた。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: なんで？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だって………お父さんもお母さんもいないなんて………かわいそう。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺がかわいそう？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そうかなあ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺、毎日、楽しいよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: じいちゃん、頑固者だし年はとってるけど、面白いんだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 今ね、あたらしい芸を覚えているところなんだ。見せてあげようか？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 何の？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺、じいちゃんといろんな街で、芸をやって食ってるんだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: それって………もしかして、大道芸人の事？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そう、それ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: へぇ、何だ、お前も知ってんだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そりゃあ、まあね。新宿や渋谷とかあっちこっちでよく見かけるもの。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そう………大道芸人なんだ。凄いのね………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: でもさ、お前も芸人なんだろ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: もちろん………ま、同じ芸人には違いないけど、正確には芸能人っていうの。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ふうん。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: それ、どっちが偉いんだ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: はあ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だから、芸能人と大道芸人ってさ、どっちが偉くて有名なんだ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: どっちって………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うふふ………芸能人に決まってるわ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: なんと言っても、全国ネットのＴＶに出れば、日本中の人に見てもらえるんだもの。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: へえ！　じゃあ、お前、すっごい偉いんだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: すげーな、お前。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………そんな。別にたいした事じゃないわよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: それに、芸能人っていっても、本当はそんなに偉くはないの。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 本当に偉くていばっているのは、プロデューサーとかプロダクションの社長とか、そういう人たち………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: それに代理店の人やお金を出してくれるスポンサーの企業とか、他にも一杯いるわ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ふうん。一杯いるんだな、偉い奴って。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そう。それに馬鹿な大人も一杯いるわ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 馬鹿な奴が偉いの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ま、そうかもしれないわね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: けど、どの世界でも、みんなそんなものよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 馬鹿で汚い大人だったら、偉くて威張ってられるのかもね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ふうん………馬鹿だと偉くなれるんだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: じゃあ俺って、あんまり馬鹿じゃないんだなぁ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ねぇ、ところでさ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………何で、あなたがこのビルに？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 何でって。歩いてきたよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そうじゃなくて、何の用事でここに来たのって聞いてるの。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: なんだ、そういう事か。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うん………じいちゃんが、これを持って、ここのビルの３０階の先生のところへ行けって言われてさ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 先生？　先生って？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 佐々木とかいう医者だって。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ふうん………その先生にその手紙を？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ちょっといい？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: いいけど………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 委任状………？

strings.jp: へぇ、お前、字読めるんだ。頭いいんだなあ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あ、あんたね………こんな字ぐらい、この年だったら読めて当然よ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 変な事、聞くようだけど、気、悪くしないでね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: いいよ。何さ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: もしかして、あなた学校に行った事は………？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ううん………俺、学校嫌いだし、じいちゃんが行かなくていいって言ってたから。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: じゃあ………全然、行った事ないの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うん。ないよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ちょっと、それっていけない事よ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あなたのおじいさん、ちゃんと保護者届を出しているのかしら………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: さあ？　そういう難しい事、俺、わかんないもん。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: な、なに？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あなたって、いったいいくつなの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そんなの、しらないよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あなた、自分の年もわからないの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: いったい、どういう育て方をされたのかしら………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: いいじゃん別に。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺、年しらなくても困った事ないもん。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ま、でも、私とそんなに変わらないって感じよね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ふうん………そうかなあ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: お前、いくつなんだ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うふふふっ。いくつに見える？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うーんと………１０才ぐらいかな？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: なによ、それ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………私がガキって言いたいの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あはっ、違ったかな？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: んじゃあ、１２才？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………もういいわよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: どーせ私、ガキだもん。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: で、でもさ、有名なんだろ？　お前ってさ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まあね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 一応、今年のレコード大賞で新人賞を受ける予定よ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: レコード？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: えっ？　お前、歌なんか歌うのか？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 嘘だあ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 本当よ！　私、これでもアルバムを５枚も出しているんだから！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: アルバム？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そう、私、本業は歌手だもの。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 嘘だろ。お前みたいな子供が、歌手だなんてさ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あんた、歌、聴いた事あるの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あるよ。じぃちゃんの持ってるレコードで、はるみとかいう人とか、チーターとか。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そういう人たちもいるけど、私たちぐらいの年齢の子だって、歌手をやってるのよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 嘘だあ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………本当だってば！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: じゃあ、証拠を見せてやるわよ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うふっ………どう？　これで信じた？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: お前………すげー歌下手くそなんだなあ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ムカッ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: もういいわよ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ごめん………怒った？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………もう、知らない！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あ～あ………もうこんな時間だわ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺、腹へった。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そうね………私も。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まったく………イブの日だっていうのに、何で私がこんな目に会わなくちゃいけないのよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: イブって………そうか、ケーキの日か。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ちょっと違うけど、まあ、そんなものかもね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ちょっと、こっちへ来てみて。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: えっ？　何でさ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: いいから、ほらっ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: な、なんだよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 髪、ぼさぼさよ………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………待って………今、クシでとかしてあげるから。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: い、いいよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 駄目よ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 仮にも女の子と一緒にいるんだから、身なりぐらいキチンとするのがエチケットでしょ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: エッチ………なんなの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: エチケット………身だしなみの事よ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: こうして見ると、結構、ハンサムじゃない。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ハムサンド？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ハンサムって言ったの！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………もうちょっと、髪、切れば、「鏡崎」より、ずっといい男かも………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 誰、それ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うん………今、女の子たちに人気のタレントよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………私の出ているドラマで共演しているの。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ふうん………じゃあ、好きなんだ、その鏡崎ってやつが。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………誰が………誰が、あんな奴なんかの事を。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………な、なんでもないわよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だって、泣いてるじゃない。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ち、違うわよ………泣いてなんか………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そいつにいじめられたの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………うるさいわね………放っておいてよ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………ご、ごめん。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 馬鹿ね………私って。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あなたに怒ったってしょうがないのにね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………ごめんね。大声出して。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: う、ううん………別にいいよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………あ、あのさ。その鏡餅とかいう奴、お前の事、いじめているんだったら、俺がとっちめてやろうか？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うふふっ………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………ありがとう。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: でも………もういいの。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あいつの事なんか、もう忘れたから………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: {@m0}って………呼んでもいい？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うん、別にいいよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺もお前の事、麻梨って呼ぶから。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: えへへへ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 麻梨って、何か、可愛いなあ………。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: こんなに可愛いのって、他にいなかったよなあ。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 辰吉のおっちゃんが飼っていた子犬も、このぐらい可愛かったよなあ。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うん、でも、やっぱり、麻梨の方が少し可愛いかもなあ。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: これは………新聞の切り抜き？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: １９８１年１２月………ずいぶん古い新聞ね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………“２４日の未明、新宿区内で相次いで変死体が発見………。”
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: “警視庁によると、２３日の深夜から２４日の未明までに、区内１３カ所でミイラ化した変死体を発見………。”
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: “同庁は悪質ないたずらとして、このミイラとおぼしき遺体を科研で分析したところ………。”
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: “変死体はいずれも、造りものや寺院等から盗まれたものではなく、２３日深夜に死亡したものと判明………。”
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: “また、遺体の遺留品から、持ち主と遺体が同一人物である事も確認された………。”
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: “同庁は、この事からすぐに死体遺棄事件から大量殺人事件へと捜査を拡大、現在目撃者の情報収集にあたっている模様。”
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………何なのこれ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: さあ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ふうん………こんな事件があったなんて初耳ね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………何で、こんな切り抜きが入れてあったのかしら。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 捜索
strings.note: a chapter title

strings.jp: {@o1}{@a0}{@q0}{@s2}正面にはエレベーターのトビラ………。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そしてボタンが並ぶパネルとインターホン………。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ここの非常呼び出しボタンは何の反応も無かった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 次に天井………。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 上まで高さは優に２メートル以上ある。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 足場が無ければ、とても天井には手が届きそうもない。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 床には少し硬めのカーペットが敷いてあるだけで、特に何もありそうになかった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: さらに僕らの背後には何の変哲も無い冷たい壁………。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: さて………どこを調べてみようか？
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
