a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そうよ。東京に遊びに来たの。ホテル代を浮かす為に私のマンションに泊まっていっただけ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: けど、いとこって言ったって、お前………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あはははっ、いやだぁ、彼、結婚してるのよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: それに私のマンションに泊まったの、彼だけじゃなくて、奥さんも一緒だもの。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………まさか、あんた本気で私と敏夫がつきあっていると思ってたわけ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: じゃあ、あの後輩は？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 桐原クンの事？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ああ。お前んちの前で、よく待っているって聞いたぜ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺も実際に何度か見かけたしな。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 彼、うちの大学の演劇部の後輩よ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 万年金欠症で、金貸してくれって、いつも泣きついてくるの。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: それで？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: それでって………それだけよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あんた、なんか変な誤解してない？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………じゃ、じゃあ、何で俺を避けるようになったんだよ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: とぼけちゃって………決まってるでしょ！　あんたが浮気したからよ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 浮気？　何だよ浮気って？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 那未川さなえちゃんって子、あんたの新しい彼女なんでしょ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: い、いや………彼女は別に………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 何よ？　あんた、自分で言ったじゃない、俺には新しい彼女がいるからって！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そ、それは、てっきりお前が浮気していると思って言ったでまかせで………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 嘘ばっかり！　あんたがあの子と駅前の喫茶店で会っているの、私、知ってるんだから！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 本当だって！　彼女、岡部がつきあっている女なんだよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 友達の彼女に手出すなんて、最低ね！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 違うって！　最後まで聞けよ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あの頃、さなえちゃんから相談を受けたんだよ、岡部と喧嘩したんで、どうすれば仲直りできるかって。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: それで、飯をおごってもらう条件で、何回か会って相談に乗ってあげただけだって。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だいたい、あんなブリっ子、俺の趣味じゃねぇよ………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: じゃあなんで、さなえちゃんとつき合っているなんて言ったのよ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だから、それはお前が浮気していると思って、つい頭にきて、その場のいきおいで言っただけの事だよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 本当に彼女とは何にも無かったの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: お前もしつこいな！　本当だって！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: これが嘘を言ってる顔に見えるか？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ま、嘘を言っているようには見えないわね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………なあ、俺たちって、何でこうなっちまったんだ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 何でって………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まったく………馬鹿らしいぜ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だいたい、お前がいけないんだぞ。知らない男を引っ張りこんで、何の説明もしなかったから。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 何よ！　あんたが勝手に早とちりしただけじゃない。人のせいにしないでよね！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: それに、もとはと言えば、あんたが………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………ふう………下らないわ。何でこんな事で怒んなくちゃならないのよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 結局、お互いを誤解していただけなんだな。俺たちって。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 馬鹿な話………本当に馬鹿みたいだわ、私たち。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そんな事で１年間も無駄にしちゃったなんて。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺だって………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………俺だって、お前が欲しがっていた、あのブローチ買ってたんだぜ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: バイトまでしてさ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………ブローチって、まさか、私が昔、言っていた奴？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: えっ！………嘘でしょ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………だって、あれもの凄く高いのよ？　{@m0}なんかのこづかいじゃ死んだって買えないぐらいするのよ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だから、バイトの梯子をして買ったんだよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: お前の誕生日にと思ってな。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………けど、捨てちまったよ。もう必要ないと思ってドブ川にさ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 捨てたって………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 馬鹿ね！　何でそんなもったいない事を。売れば少しは回収できたのに。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だって、お前…………そんなもん持っていてもしょうがねぇだろ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そん時はもう必要無いと思ったんだからさ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: {@m0}………今、つき合っている子はいるの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: いねぇって言っただろ。だいたいそんな気分になれるかよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………お前はどうなんだよ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………私もいないわ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………ううん。何でもない。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 第５章　無理矢理
strings.note: a chapter title

strings.jp: 馬鹿っ！　な、何、考えてんのよ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺は本能の赴くまま、まりに襲いかかった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 今まで溜まっていた何かが俺の「たが」を緩めたのだろう。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: もう、自分でも押さえようは無かった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うるせー！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………だいたい、お前がいけないんだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: お前が………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: じょ、状況を考えなさいよ！　こんな事をしている場合じゃないでしょう？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: や、やめて………{@m0}。お、お願いだから。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まりの瞳にうっすらと涙が浮かんでいた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺は一瞬、その涙にハッとなって………。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: {@cf}手を緩めた
strings.note: a menu choice: one line

strings.jp: {@cf}そのまま下着を引きずり下ろした
strings.note: a menu choice: one line

strings.jp: 俺はハッとなって手を緩めた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: な、何をしてんだ………俺。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まったく………いったい、どういうつもりよ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: わ、わりぃ………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: つい、ムラムラっとなって、お前の事を抱きたくなっちまって………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………だいたい、お前が誘うような態度を取るからいけないんだぞ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あんな風にされたら、誰だって我慢できねぇよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: な、なんだよ。人の顔、ジロジロ見て。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ただ………{@m0}が、まだ私を抱きたいと思っているなんて、ちょっとびっくりしちゃったから。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………あ、あたりまえだろ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あれだけおあずけくっといて、結局、何もさせてくれずに、ハイさよならだったもんな。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 何よ………それじゃあ、まるで私が悪いみたいじゃない。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 馬鹿、お前から振っておいて、よくそんな事を言えるな。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 振った？　私が？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ちょっと、それ、どういう事よ！？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だから、お前が先に男を作ったんじゃないかよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 私に彼氏なんかいるわけないでしょ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だが俺は、まりの言葉を無視して、そのまま下着を引きずり下ろした。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: いやぁっ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 大きくなった自分の分身をまりの熱い部分の中に強引に埋める。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 駄目っ！　私、まだ処………あうっ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: めりっという妙な感触とともに、まりの中へ侵入した。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………あうっ！　ひ、ひどいっ………{@m0}の馬鹿っ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: う、うるせー！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: こうなったら、今までの鬱憤を全部はらさせてもらうからな！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: お前の身体の穴という穴に、俺のザーメンをタップリと注ぎ込んでやる！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: どうだ！？　嫌いな男のイチモツをくわえこんだ感想は？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: くぅ………うううっ、さ、最低………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あんたって最低よっ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ふ、ふん！　最低で結構だ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: どうせ、こんな機会は二度と無いんだからな！　腰が立たなくなるまで犯しまくってやるぜ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そうまくしたてると、俺は乱暴に腰を動かし、ズンズンとまりの内蔵にとどくほど突きまくった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: どうだ！　感じるんだろ？　お前のオ○ンコがヒィヒィ言って喜んでるぜ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: う、うううっ………馬鹿っ！　早く済ませてよっ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ふん！　言われなくたって、出してやるよ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺はさらに激しく突きながら、手荒にクリトリスを刺激した。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: その瞬間、俺は………。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: {@cf}まりの中で果てた
strings.note: a menu choice: one line

strings.jp: {@cf}まりの中から引き抜いた
strings.note: a menu choice: one line

strings.jp: まりの中で果てた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あ………何、これっ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あああ！　いやあああああああああああああああっ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 放出し終わり、ズッポリとまりの膣から引き抜くと、ゴボッと白く濁った体液がこぼれ出た………。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まりの中から引き抜いた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そして軽く何度かしごいて、そのまままりの身体の前に放出した。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ああっ………いやっ………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ふふふっ………見ろよ、お前の腹の上、俺のザーメンだらけだぜ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うっ………ううううっ………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あ！　あ！　あ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あああああっ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: さてと………もう、このぐらいで勘弁してやるか。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: それから俺は、さらに３回に渡って、言葉通り、穴という穴に自分の欲望をぶちまけ続けた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まりは１回目の後は、もうただグッタリと人形のように横たわったまま、俺にされるままだった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だが、俺は少しも罪悪感は抱かなかった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: いや、むしろ、これで仕返しができたと思い、満足だった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: フッ………どうだ？　タップリと俺のザーメンを注ぎ込まされた感想は？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うっく………ううううっ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: こんな気持ちいいもんだったら、もっと早く欲しかったってか？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: くくくっ………ま、そんな訳はねぇか。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: お前も気持ち良かったんだからよ、このぐらい大目にみろよな。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 長い行為からしばらくした後………。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺は軽い目眩を覚えた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: くそっ………何だか頭がクラクラするぜ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うううっ………それに寒気も。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 風邪でもひいたかな。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………薬………あるわよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………風邪薬あるけど………飲む？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: な、何だ………急に優しくなったな、まりの奴。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 悪いな………だったら、もらうよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: な、何だこれ………薬にしちゃやけにでかいな。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 液体だから、すぐに効くわ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………そ、そうか？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: じゃあ、ちょっとだけ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ゴクっ………ゴクっ………。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………ぷふぁ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 苦くもなくて、なかなかいける味じゃないか。ビタミン剤みたいだ。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: サンキュ………これは本当に効きそうだぜ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: お礼なんていいわよ………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………だって………あなたが飲んだそれ………風邪薬なんかじゃないんだもの。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そ、そ、そ、そりゃ………どういう事だ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………それ………ネズミ駆除用の殺虫剤。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………何だって！？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: さ、殺虫剤！？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………うふふ………馬鹿ね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だいたい、あんな目にあわされた後の女が差し出すものぐらい、予想つかなかった？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………本当………あんたってマヌケね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺は真っ青になって、急いで喉に指を突っ込んでもどそうとした………。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………吐いたって手遅れよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 後、２０秒ぐらいで効果が現れて………あんたは確実に悶死するのよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: く、くそっ！　ふ、ふざけやがって！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺の鼓動は早鐘のように鳴り響き、だんだん苦い物が口の中にこみ上げてきた………。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: て、てめぇ！　な、何のマネだ！　やめろぉっ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: やめろ！　やめてくれっ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: やだ！　お、俺は死にたくないっ！　やだーっ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: {@s2}俺はそのまま床に倒れ込んだ………。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 突然、まりが近づいて意味深な笑みを浮かべて聞いてきた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: な、何だよ………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 彼女もいないんじゃ、だいぶ溜まってるんでしょう？　{@m0}のココ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………ま、まあな。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: してあげようか？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………何だって？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 抜いてあげましょうかって言ったの。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………ば、馬鹿やろう。く、下らない冗談はよせよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: どうせ、その気もないくせに。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だいたい、１年間もつきあっていて、お前、俺に指一本触らせなかったじゃないか。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………怒っているんだ。まだその事。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 当たり前だろ。いつも途中でお預けだったじゃないか。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: けど、あの時はどうしてもそう出来なかったの。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………下らないと思うけど、私ね、二十歳になるまで処女を失いたくなかったの。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だから、私………{@m0}がしたいのをわかっていながら、ずっと誘いを断っていた。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………な、何だ………そ、そうだったのかよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だったら、早く言ってくれればいいものを。俺はまたてっきり………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うふふ………遊ばれているだけかと思った？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………でも、嬉しかったな。{@m0}ったら私が何もさせないのに辛抱強くずっとつき合ってくれたんだもの。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 今だから言うけど、{@m0}とつき合う半年前に、私、別な彼がいたの。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ん？　な、何だよ、そんな話、初耳だぞ！？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うふふ………心配しないで。その彼とは何ともなかったから。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: その彼、私がなかなか身体を許さないから、もの凄く怒ってね。ある時、私を酔わせて無理矢理犯そうとしたの。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: でも、こんな奴に処女を奪われたくないと思って、思いっきり急所をけっ飛ばして逃げちゃった。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うん………その後、彼から花束と一緒に、もう一度ヨリを戻したいって手紙が送られてきたわ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 傑作なのがバラの花束の中に入っていた鍵よ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 何の鍵だと思う？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: マンションよ。それも麻布にある。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 私の為にわさわざ購入したものだから、好きに使ってくれって………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: くーっ、キザな奴！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ね？　だから花束ごとゴミ箱に捨ててやったわ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ふうん………ま、ちょっともったいない気もするが。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: これが、私の二つある恋愛経験の内の一つのあらまし。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ま、残りは言わなくてもわかっているわよね？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 一つ聞くけど………今だったら、させてくれるの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: さあ………どうでしょ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: どっちなんだよ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………それは………{@m0}次第かな？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ちぇっ。やっぱり駄目なんだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そんな事ないわよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 何だったら試してあげましょうか？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ど、どうやって？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 言ったでしょう？　抜いてあげようかって。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: {@cf}冗談だろ？
strings.note: a menu choice: one line

strings.note: a menu choice: one line

strings.jp: 冗談だろ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………本気って言ったら？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そりゃあ、お前………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: けど、何で今さらのように突然、そんなこと言い出すんだよ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………もしかしたら、私たち、ここで死んじゃうのかもしれないじゃない。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: それに、このまま死んじゃったら、あの世でも{@m0}に恨みごとを言われちゃいそうだしね………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………ズボン、下げるわよ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………凄い。結構、大きいんだ………{@m0}の。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: こうやって間近で見ると、本当にエイリアンみたい………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: わ、悪かったな。人のをバケモンみたいに言うなっ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うふふ………ごめん。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まりは、俺の竿を取り出すと、ゆっくりとしごきはじめた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 細く冷たい指先が何とも言えない感触だった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 気持ちいい？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ま、まあな………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………自分でするよりは、いいかな。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: それ、誉めてるつもり？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まりの手はさらに動き続ける。たまらず俺は呻き声を漏らす。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………あっ………透明なのが出てきた。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うふふっ、おもしろいわね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ねぇ、口でしてあげようか？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: お、お前………出来るのかよ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ものは試しよ。それとも手でいいの？

strings.jp: い、いいよ。無理するなよ。

strings.jp: 無理なんてしてないわ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: {@m0}のだから………別に何とも思わないよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そ、そうか。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………だったら、ついでに服も脱いで頼む。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: えーっ！　服も脱ぐの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 駄目？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………も、もう………しょうがないわね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: じゃあ、上だけだったら………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まりはしぶしぶ服を脱ぎ始めた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………まどろっこしいな、ほらっ、パァーと脱いじゃえよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺はまりのセーターをまくり上げた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ああん！　もう………強引なんだから。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そうそう、ついでにジーンズの方もさ………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………あっ、駄目よっ………こらっ、やりすぎよ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ちぇっ………ケチ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………ふうん………しかしお前、変わったよな。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: な、何がよ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 下着の趣味。前よりエッチになった。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………馬鹿。私だって、もう大人の女よ。いつまで子供っぽいのなんて着けてられないわ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: へえ、お前も成長するんだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: も、とは何よ、も、とは。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………馬鹿、冗談だよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: それより………いいのか？　本当にさ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………ここまでしちゃったら今さら嫌とも言えないじゃない。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ま、それもそうだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺は床にしゃがむと、そそり立った自分のモノを遠慮なくまりの顔に突き出した。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まりは少し躊躇うと、意を決しパクリと俺のモノをくわえ込んだ。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うっ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ちゅるっ………ど、どう、感想は？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うふっ。ココ………感じるんでしょ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うっ………す、凄く感じる。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ちゅる………んはっ………{@m0}の先っぽから、滲み出てるね………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 舐めても舐めても、きりがないみたい。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: か、火山の噴火前と似たようなもんだからな。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………ちょっと、噛むね？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あっ………強く噛むなよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: んふふっ………カリッ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: くっ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: な、なあ、お、俺………そろそろ………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: っはあ………出そうなの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あ、ああ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: つ、ついでにといったら何だけどさ………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: んっ………飲んで欲しいの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: い、いいわよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ほ、本当？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うん。一度、飲んでみたかったから………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そ、それじゃあ………お言葉に甘えて。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まりっ！　だ、出すぞ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………頂戴っ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺の先端から白い飛沫が飛び散る。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あんっ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 大量のザーメンが、まりの顔に降り注ぎ、あごから乳房へと滴り落ちた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ああん………髪の毛にもついちゃったじゃない。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………もう、顔にかけていいなんて言ってないでしょ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あ、あははは、わりぃ………ついＡＶの真似をしてみたくなって。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 馬鹿ね！　………もう。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺はまりの顎を伝わり落ちる滴をすくうと、そのまままりの口に運んだ。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 精液ってどんな味なんだ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………うん………ちょっと苦い感じ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 私が飲ませてあげようか？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そう言うと、まりは俺にキスしてきた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まりの舌が俺の口の中に入り込み、二人の舌が絡み合った。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………っはあ。どう？　自分の精液のお味は？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うげげげっ………気持ちわるうー。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うふふふ………それを私が飲んであげたんだからね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 感謝しなさいよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………ふう………やれやれ、とんだ勉強をさせられたもんだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………さて、いつまでもこんな事をしていても仕方が無いな。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 何を始める気よ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 決まっているだろ、ここから出る方法を探すんだよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………ここから出る方法？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: でも、下は駄目だったじゃない？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まだ、上が残っているさ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ほらっ、さっき使ったロープを上に引っかければ、天井まで登れるんじゃないかな？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 肩車すれば、何とか上までは届くんだ………そのぐらい出来んだろう。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うん………できるかも。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: よし、なら善は急げだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: どうせなら、下の口の方がいいな。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………だ、駄目よ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 今は駄目っ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: いいじゃないかよ、どうせするんだったら、早いうちにした方が新鮮だし。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ちょ、ちょっと！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ああっ！　ちょ、ちょっと………待ってったら！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: へぇ！　お前、こんなエッチな下着を着けるようになったんだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………ああっ！　ちょっと………駄目だって、もう！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: お願いよ！　{@m0}！　今は堪忍してっ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ふふふっ、何を生娘みたいなセリフを………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 今時、バージンを守るなんて流行らないぜ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺は自分のズボンのチャックを下ろすと、挿入の準備にかかった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 駄目………やめて………お願い………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 心配するなって………ほらっ、そこに立ってお尻を向けて。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ねぇ………やっぱり、やめようよ………こんな事。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 今さら遅いぜ………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あああ、こ、恐いっ………駄目っ、入れちゃ………入れないで………{@m0}っ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺はグイッとまりの尻を押さえつけると、一気にその花園の奥に入り込んだ。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: めりっ、という感触とともに貫通に成功すると、何度か軽くピストン運動を試みた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: すると俺の竿は次第に真っ赤に染まっていく。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 開通の証だった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 血………結構、出るんだな。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あっ！　い、痛いっ！………ぬ、抜いてっ、抜いてよっ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………大丈夫。何度か動けば自然に慣れるって。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うううっ………わ、私の………バージンが………うううっ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺は泣き崩れそうになるまりの身体を支え、今度は深々とストロークを行った。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: すると、その度に、真っ赤な血と混ざりあった二人の分泌物がとくとくと結合部から溢れ、滴り落ちた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: その光景に、俺はようやくまりと結ばれた事を実感した。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: それがたとえ、多少、強引な手段であっても、まりの処女を自分が貫いたという事実は俺を満足な気分にさせた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まり………まりっ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺は激しく、まりの身体に自分の欲望をぶつけた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そして瞬く間に、絶頂の時が訪れた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺は慌てて、膣内から自分のモノを取り出すと、その上のピンク色の菊座の中に挿入した。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 途端に、まりは悲鳴を上げたが、俺は無視して一気に貫いた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 当然、そこも未経験な為、かなり狭く思ったように突く事は出来なかった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ただ、何度か出し入れする度に、まりの肛門の裏の鮮やかな内蔵色の直腸部がめくれ上がり、その卑猥な光景が俺の絶頂を加速させた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: だ、出すぞっ、まり！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: びゅっ、びゅっ………と、まりの直腸にザーメンの飛沫を放出する。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あうっ………へ、変な感じ………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まりは腰をくねらせ抵抗したが、俺は全てを放出し終えるまで、その尻をグッと押さえ込んだ。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 長い長い、放出を終え、ズボッ、とまりのアヌスから引き抜くと、大量の体液がどろりと溢れ出た。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: それと同時に、まりはぶるるっと身体を震わせ、たまらず放尿をはじめた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ああっ………駄目ぇっ………見ないでっ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 絶頂を迎えたまりはガクガクと身体を震わせて、そのまま壁際に崩れ落ちた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: その後、俺は二度、まりに放った。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 今までの積もり積もった思いが、そうさせたのかもしれない。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 二人は汗と体液にまみれ、ようやく最後の行為が終わると、互いにその場にぐったりと倒れ込んだ。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………ちょっと、やりすぎたかな、俺。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………う、うううっ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 何だよ、俺にバージンをくれる予定だったんだろ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そりゃあ、ちょっとばかり強引だったかもしれないけど………でも、そんなに泣かなくたっていいじゃないか。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うううっ………馬鹿………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あんたなんか………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あんたなんか、大嫌いっ………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ああ、そうかよ………わかったよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ちぇっ、俺に処女をくれるつもりが無いんだったら、最初からそう言えばいいのによ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………まったく。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まりとの後味の悪いセックスの後、俺は疲れはて、そのままぐっすり寝込んでしまった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 夢の中で、裸で泣きじゃくる、まりの姿が浮かんでは消えていった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ああ………何で俺はあんな事をしちまったのかな。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 本当はあんな形であいつを抱くつもりじゃなかったのに。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: トビラの開く音で、俺はようやく目を覚ました。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………開いたわよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: まりの冷たく無感情な声が聞こえた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}
a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: {@m0}………ちょっといい？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 手加減無しのまりの平手打ちが、俺の頬を直撃した。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: さようなら………{@m0}。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: これ、あんたにあげるわ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………あんた一人で泊まれば。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: じゃあね。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そう言ってまりは一人で、さっさと出て行った。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺は頬に残る痛みも忘れ、まりから手渡させたものを見た。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: それはとあるホテルのツインルームの鍵だった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………あいつ、何でこんなものを。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: すると、なぜか自然に俺の目に涙が溢れてきた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 止めようとしても、次から次へと溢れて、どうしょうもなかった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ば、馬鹿野郎………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 一人でツインに泊まれる訳ないじゃないか………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うううっ………くそっ………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺は………俺は何て大馬鹿野郎なんだ………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: {@s2}俺はその鍵を握りしめ、せっかくのチャンスを自分からふいにした事に腹をたてながら泣いた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: じゃあ、頼む………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺はチャックを下ろし、自分のモノをまりに突き出した。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: うわ………こ、こんな大きいんだ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ううっ、グロい………やっぱりやめようかしら。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: おいおい、お前が言い出したんじゃないかよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………わ、わかっているわよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ゆ、指でちょっと触れるだけよ？　いい？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: と、まりが俺のモノを掴もうとした途端………。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: な、何だよ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: い、今、壁を黒いのが横切ったの！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 黒いもの？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そんなものどこにも………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: と、天井の格子を見上げると一匹の小さなネズミの姿があった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あははは、ネズミだよ、ネズミ。ほらっ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺は突然、背中を叩かれて、現実の世界に引き戻された。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: もういいよ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: マリは少し照れたように、顔を背けて言った。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あ………ああ。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そ、そう………よかった。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: なぜか二人ともぎこちなかった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ついさっきまでは、単なる幼馴染みだったのに、今の俺たちの間には別の空気が流れていた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: それとも、俺がただ意識しすぎているだけなのだろうか？
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あっ、な、何よ、あんた………。
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: マリは突然、俺の下半身を見て、顔を真っ赤に染めた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺は自分のズボンを見ると、大きく隆起した自分のものに気がついて慌てた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: な、何考えてんのよ！………エッチ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ば、馬鹿！　違うよ！　そ、そんなんじゃねぇよ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: そう否定しても、大きくなった部分がなかなか元に戻らず、俺は腰を引くようにして再び背を向けた。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あんた、もしかして変な事、考えてない？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ば、馬鹿、な、何で、へ、変な事なんか、か、考えるんだよ！
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 図星だった為か、俺はしどろもどろになってしまった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: それからしばらく二人は互いにそっぽを向いて口も効かずにいた。

strings.jp: 今月の＜学園盗撮団＞って………ええと………。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: 俺は鮮明に思い出した今月号の巻頭ページの内容に愕然とした。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あれは女子トイレで用を足す女の姿を隠し撮りしたものだった。
strings.note: a message: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: あまりにも凄い内容だった為、またいつもの雑誌のやらせかと思っていた。

strings.jp: でも………まさか、あれがマリだなんて！

strings.jp: ………う、嘘だろ？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ほ、本当なのか？
strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.note: a line of dialogue: any length (lines broken at the window's edge); \n a new line; keep {@xx}

strings.jp: ………他の場所でも、よくやってるらしいわ。

strings.jp: なぜだかわからなかった。
